about.storyP1: Amaphulo aseKenya namhlanje aqhutywa ziingqiqo kunye neembono ezivela kubacebisi.
about.storyP2: Abaphumeleleyo nabalahlekelweyo bahlala benqunywa yinhlanhla, hayi ubukre.
about.storyP4: Sisakha inkqubo apho zonke izigqibo zopolitiko zixhaswa bubukrelekrele bokwenyani, obuqhubekayo. hayi ukuqagela
about.visionText: Iinkokheli zenza izigqibo ngokusekwe kubukrelekrele, hayi ithamsanqa.
about.p1Desc: Yakhelwe isiSwahili neSheng ukusukela ngosuku lokuqala. Akuzona iimodeli zesiNgesi ezilungiselelwe iMpuma ye-Afrika.
about.p2Desc: Idatha yabaviwa azisabelwana ngazo. Iphulo ngalinye libona ulwazi lwayo kuphela.
about.p3Title: Ìwọ́lé tí ó bá ìdájọ́ òdodo mu
about.p3Desc: Amaxabiso acwangciselwe ukuba umviwa wokuqala we-MCA akwazi ukufikelela kwizixhobo ezifanayo nomkhankaso karhulumente.
about.p4Desc: Nigo tonyare korua obongaini bweka bokomanyekanire kobua obwansu emerongo etano.

bios.morris: Ukuqhubela phambili umbono nokukhula kweKampeni. Ukwakha ipulatifomu yokuqala yezobuntlola bezopolitiko eKenya yokutshintsha indlela abaholi abenza ngayo izinqumo
bios.barak: Ukwakha ingqalasizinda eguqula amajelo eendaba aseKenya abe yingcaphephe yomkhankaso. Ngaphambili kwakhiwe iinkqubo zedatha zama-fintechs aseMpuma Afrika
bios.albert: Ukusingatha ipulatifomu eyisisekelo  kusuka kumapayipi wedatha namamodeli e-NLP kuya kudeshibhodi imikhankaso ethembela kuyo njalo ekuseni.
bios.john: Ukujonga isicwangciso sezemali sikaKampeni kunye nokuqinisekisa ukuba iqonga lijongene ngokuzinzileyo kwimeko yezopolitiko yaseKenya.
bios.anwar: Ukuhola isu lezombusazwe nobudlelwane bamakhasimende kulo lonke elaseKenya. Ukuvala igebe phakathi kwedatha yezobunhloli nezinqumo zangempela zomkhankaso
